cells.gaps: No source from the last three years naming a public body, system or product tested, audited or certified against the standards is held.
cells.note: Decree 2021-913 adopts the RGI's list of technical standards (CIV-001) and its article 3 binds public bodies to conform to it (CIV-002). Stage 5 needs a system checked against the RGI in the last three years, and none is held.
